scene: At the pavilion platform, three curious transit routes await your ticket.
picture: A wide flat side view of a stone transit terrace. On the far left sits a red mountain cable tram. The player stands left of centre in lilac headscarf and mustard coat. At centre, a river barge rests by steps. On the far right, a glass-roofed trolley awaits on rails.
shown: a dangling red cable tram car hooked to thick wires on the far left
a wooden river barge bobbing at the wooden dock platform at centre
a bright green glass-roofed trolley resting on gleaming rails on the far right
